title: ‘Republicans Are Trying To Distract You’: Former Wisconsin Democratic Leader Lays Out How to Win in November
author: John Harwood
content:
People often associate Wisconsin with cold weather, stellar cheese, and of
course, their swing state politics. But what many people don't know is that
for over a decade, the state's democratic institutions have been under attack
by the Wisconsin GOP's partisan
[gerrymandering,](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/nov/20/deliberate-
and-anti-democratic-wisconsin-grapples-with-partisan-gerrymandering) [power
grabs,](https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2018/12/4/18123784/gop-
legislature-wisconsin-michigan-power-grab-lame-duck) and [voter
suppression.](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jan/12/wisconsin-
republican-brags-low-democratic-turnout)

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In this Substack Live, **Zeteo 's** **John Harwood** is joined by Wisconsin's
former Democratic Party chair, **[Ben
Wikler](https://substack.com/@benwikler)** - who has spent years helping the
state's Democrats fight back against the GOP. In the conversation, Wikler lays
out his plan for helping Democrats take back democracy, as outlined in his new
[book,](https://bookshop.org/p/books/this-is-the-plan-how-to-end-america-s-
meltdown-and-save-democracy-ben-wikler/284c2d14677a8f6e) _This Is the Plan._

Wikler also discusses Wisconsin's upcoming gubernatorial race, where
Republican [Tom
Tiffany](https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/08/04/tom-
tiffany-heads-into-general-election-with-nearly-5m-in-cash/91161111007/?gnt-
cfr=1&gca-cat=p&gca-uir=true&gca-
epti=z11xx48p119150l003850c119150e1102xxv11xx48d--34--b--34--&gca-ft=214&gca-
ds=sophi) could be set to face off with democratic socialist [Francesca
Hong](https://zeteo.com/p/socialist-wisconsin-francesca-
hong?utm_source=publication-search).

**" Republicans are trying to distract you from the fact that they're trying
to rip you off, that life is so hard to afford right now. And Tom Tiffany is
part of the problem,"** Wikler tells Harwood.
